insights.title: Title
insights.quotaHelp: Account quota from the native sign-in, across devices. It cannot be allocated as charges to local tasks.
insights.usageHelp: Readable logs on this device, grouped by event time in the Connector device’s local time. Cached tokens are part of input; reasoning tokens are part of output.
insights.modelHelp: Requested model configuration in the log, not a confirmed execution model.
insights.taskHelp: Tasks are ordered by latest update, 10 per page. Search covers all indexed tasks. Child tasks are counted separately.
insights.turnHelp: Newest turns first. Duration includes tools and waiting; average output is not generation speed. Status reflects the last log event.
insights.responseHelp: Modern responses take precedence and are deduplicated by identity. Legacy deltas and compaction references are not added again.
insights.toolHelp: Tools are linked by call ID. A return does not establish success; bytes are not tokens.
insights.bindingHelp: Only a local task identity supplied by the host is linked automatically. Select local records manually for cloud, other-device or unidentified tasks; selection affects this panel only.
insights.sourceHelp: Covers readable sessions and archived_sessions on this device. Cloud, other-device and account attribution coverage is unknown. Cost and credits are unavailable.
insights.tokenHelp: Cache is a subset of input; reasoning is a subset of output. Missing or conflicting fields show —. A known subtotal is not a complete total.
insights.cachedHelp: Included in input; not added to the total again.
insights.reasoningHelp: Included in output; not added to the total again.
insights.relationsHelp: Tasks are counted separately. Unproven parent/child boundaries are not merged; compaction references are not counted again.
insights.freshHelp: Visible panels refresh every 10 seconds. Refresh reads data without creating a model turn.
insights.recordHelp: This record has conflicting or invalid fields and is not treated as a reliable total.

insights.guide.open.title: Open overview and task usage
insights.guide.open.body: Open Connector 总览 from the host’s Explore or sidebar. In a local task, choose New tab → More tools → 任务用量, or select a task in the overview. The first opening indexes local logs and refreshes automatically. Refreshing does not call a model.
insights.guide.empty.title: No tasks or usage yet
insights.guide.empty.body: Usage reads this computer’s current user’s local Codex logs. Complete a local turn in a signed-in Codex client, then refresh; existing logs do not require a new task. Other Agents are not automatically included in these token statistics. Cloud and other-device tasks without local logs do not appear. Clear filters if needed; the task list loads 10 items per page and searches all indexed tasks.
insights.guide.binding.title: Select the intended task
insights.guide.binding.body: If the host provides no valid task identity, use Select task beside the title. Choose the local task you intend to inspect; the panel never substitutes the latest task. If a cloud task cannot open a local panel, select a local task from the overview. Its data does not describe the cloud task.
insights.guide.quota.title: Missing or stale account quota
insights.guide.quota.body: Quota comes from a currently signed-in native subscription source, separately from local usage logs. Check sign-in in that client. If the source was disabled, enable it in Connector Desktop’s usage settings. Unavailable quota does not mean 100% remaining and does not block local log statistics. Account quota cannot be allocated as an individual task’s actual cost.
insights.guide.agents.title: Run work with an Agent
insights.guide.agents.body: Install and sign in to the Agent you want to use; external apps and their accounts are not bundled. Ask Local Connector to list local projects, available Agents and existing tasks, then explicitly choose what to create or continue. Opening a usage panel only reads data; it does not start a task.
insights.guide.entrypoints.title: Plugin, desktop app and remote access
insights.guide.entrypoints.body:
Local ChatGPT plugin: includes its native backend; Connector Desktop, a Tunnel and an API key are normally unnecessary.
Connector Desktop: provides tray, floating panels and connection/Agent settings.
Web, mobile or another device: requires a separately authenticated Tunnel or HTTPS ingress to this computer. Installing the plugin does not enable remote access.
insights.guide.data.title: Coverage and counting
insights.guide.data.body: Only readable local Codex logs are counted, not the account’s full activity. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets and are not added twice. Missing fields show —; a confirmed subtotal may be incomplete. Parent and child tasks are counted separately. Tool return sizes and whole-turn durations are not charges or pure generation speed. Charts filter event time; daily groups use the Connector device’s local time.
insights.guide.lifecycle.title: What happens when you close it
insights.guide.lifecycle.body: Hidden panels pause refreshing. Closing one page may leave the plugin backend running. When its last plugin or desktop client exits, the shared backend stops, including Connector-owned execution. Tasks owned by external Codex Desktop remain under that app’s control. An ordinary chat reply does not promise scheduled wakeups, ongoing waits or proactive notifications.
insights.guide.permissions.title: Access and task operations
insights.guide.permissions.body: Usage panels are read-only. The plugin also provides local project reads, file operations and Agent controls, to be used for your explicit requests. External Agents retain their own sign-in and permissions; remote ingresses authenticate separately. Removing the plugin does not automatically delete projects, original logs or external Agents.
insights.guide.connection.title: Connection failure or prolonged loading
insights.guide.connection.body: Retry first. If it persists, check that Local Connector is enabled in the host, close and reopen the panel, or restart the host when work can safely be interrupted. If both development and installed variants are present, enable only the one you intend to use. Retry also reconnects after failed host initialization.
insights.guide.version.title: Version mismatch
insights.guide.version.body: A plugin and Connector Desktop sharing one state directory must use the same native build; matching version numbers alone may not suffice. Let active work finish, close old clients using that directory, install matching artifacts and reload. Do not delete the state directory to resolve a build mismatch.
insights.guide.update.title: Still seeing the old UI after an update
insights.guide.update.body: Updating Connector Desktop does not reinstall the plugin. Install the new plugin package again, reload the host and reopen panels; replacing extracted files alone does not update its cache. If the marketplace source differs, remove the local-connector marketplace registration, register the new extracted root and install clc@local-connector. Keep the previous source and configuration until the new installation works.
insights.guide.remove.title: Uninstall and retained data
insights.guide.remove.body: Disable or remove Local Connector in the host and close its panels. Remove its marketplace registration if no other plugin uses it, then delete the extracted source. Projects, external Agents and original Codex history remain separate. Connector configuration and receipts are retained by default; uninstalling does not require clearing the state directory.
